subject: When I have to use theta parameterization when I analyze categorical ordered data like Likert scale?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: When I have to use theta parameterization when I analyze categorical ordered data like Likert scale?
parts:
Dear all,

I want to know when I have to use theta parameterization when I analyze categorical ordered data like Likert scale?

I already know I can try theta and delta parameterizations are to analyze categorical ordered data, but I do not know when -- and what the situation -- I have to try theta parameterization. If I have to try to analyze the context of the multidimensional item response theory, I have to use theta parameterization?

--
Seongho

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: When I have to use theta parameterization when I analyze categorical ordered data like Likert scale?
parts:
On 11/22/2014 07:49 AM, Seongho Bae wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I want to know when I have to use theta parameterization when I analyze
> categorical ordered data like Likert scale?

- if you want to 'mimic' the results of IRT programs
- if you want to constrain residual variances (of observed categorical
items) to be equal (eg over time)

Yves.
